messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-84721 — proxy-latency-us-west2 (5xx-rate > 3% for 2m)
pagerduty: Incident PD-84721 created and paged the on-call schedule.
sara: acking. saw the page, heading in. 
 kai: @sara thanks — any visible customer-facing errors yet? dashboards show a small bump but nothing huge.
sara: looking at grafana now: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ABc123/proxy-overview?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now
sara: main spike is 5xx-rate at the edge -> chunked 502s from the routing layer. latency spike about +120ms p95.
mike: logs show a flurry of backend timeouts to model-inference-us-west2-03 around the same time, a handful of pods restarted in the last 3m.
sara: running `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l app=inference -o wide | grep west2` — a couple are in CrashLoopBackOff.
ash: (reaction) :eyes:
kai: is this the autoscaler doing scale-downs too aggressively?
sara: possible — I can see a scale-down activity at 1756789000 from the autoscaler logs. snippet:
```
2025-06-07T22:05:00Z autoscaler: scale-to 2 -> 0 for deployment inference-west2 (grace=30s)
2025-06-07T22:05:04Z pod/inference-west2-03 terminated: OOMKilled
```
ashley: if pods OOM'd during scale down that's weird — they should drain first. Could be an upstream memory regression.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-84721 acknowledged by sara
sara: acked and pinned. temporary mitigation: scaling cluster pool back up to 4 nodes, preventing further scale-to-0 actions. running `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-west2` now.
kai: set a quick suppression for this alert channel? It's noisy while we stabilize.
sara: I've added a 15m suppression on the alert rule and bumped threshold to 5% to avoid immediate re-fires. noted in the incident timeline. `#suppress:PD-84721 15m`
mike: FYI, I spotted a rollout from yesterday that changed container memory request from 6Gi -> 3Gi on that node pool. could be related.
sara: good catch. reverting the rollout would be fastest if we need to restore memory requests. thoughts?
kai: let's not revert blind. first ensure we can stabilize: undo the scale-to-0 policy so pods don't get killed, then watch. if OOM continues, revert.
sara: rolled back cluster autoscaler config to keep min nodes=3 for west2; applied.
ashley: monitoring logs — error rate is trending down after node restore. p95 latency falling back to baseline.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-84721 auto-resolved (no active triggers)
sara: thanks — closing the page. adding follow-up ticket to infra backlog to audit the memory request change + autoscaler policy.
mike: logging follow-up: INFRA-1298 — include heap/allocator checks in post-deploy job.
kai: customer-impact-check: queued CS tickets for last 10m show 7 error reports but most are retries; no confirmed data-loss. marking SEV-LOW.
sara: handoff to next oncall @kai — please keep an eye for recurrence over the next 30m. I've documented what we changed in the incident thread.
kai: taking over. thanks @sara. quick summary in #incidents: PD-84721 transient 5xx spike in us-west2, autoscaler + memory-request change likely contributor, mitigation: set min-nodes, suppression, monitoring.
ashley: adding :white_check_mark: to timeline — will follow up with a postmortem if we get repeats.
sara: adding logs and command snippets to the ticket.
pagerduty: PD-84721 status: resolved
